title: Master Equation River: A Provenance Audit Across the Human–AI Readout Programme (Internal Programme Synthesis v1.1, glosa-checked) — การทวนสายธารสมการ เทียบกับวรรณกรรมภายใน และการชี้ที่มาของแต่ละส่วน
description_html:
Status. Internal literature review and provenance audit of the Human–AI Readout Programme (Thai with English technical terms). It arranges the equations and proposals of the programme's manuscripts into one typed, multi-level dependency architecture and states, stage by stage, which paper contributes what and why the stages compose. It does not propose that the whole river is a universal psychological law or a single physical equation: some segments are Readout/Domain architecture, some are definitions, some are Dr theses, some are Open empirical hypotheses, and some are measurement protocols. Part of the series When AI Expands Human Potential (index DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22308201). Version 1.1 is the glosa-checked revision of the 5 September v1.0: an independent review of v1.0 found three blocking citation defects (Fusion/Tunnel cited as “v7” while the deposited record is v8.1 and the retention-gate formula attributed to it is absent from v8.1; the superseded “Agency Potential” note cited as a standing source with a feasible-set potential formula; the MEMK equation attributed to an undeposited internal specification instead of Readout Genesis eq. 14) and three should-fix items (an undisclosed symbol renaming, no symbol glossary, a missing DOI); all are corrected here and the correction record is in §9 and in the Blackbox Log. Checked with the glosa methodology before deposit (citation cards for every attributed source re-located by a headless same-model route, class I1; one claim card with three adversarial route reports; independent review of the document) — knowledge state K0; the audit's own stated correction list (§4, notation to fix before any canonical freeze) is carried as open.

One-sentence conclusion (author's). The internal literature can be arranged as a continuous cycle — World → Readout → Meaning → Experience → Retention → Accessibility → Live Possibility → Choice → Agency → Feedback → Changed Reader → Human–AI → Human Return → Warrant — but where retained change persists (H_{t+1} ≠ H_t) the cycle does not return to the same person, so it is better understood as a recursive river or spiral than as a closed circle.

Sources audited. Readout Genesis / RG-MEMK; Human Learning as Epistemic Architecture; Experience Is the Human LoRA; From Problem to Hypothesis; Epistemic Fusion or Tunnel; Meaning Before Naming; Experience Is Meaning-Giving; Agency Potential (superseded by Potential as a Readout); Choice Begins Before Choice; CTSA Human-Return Readout; When AI Expands Human Potential.
